data.description: CG-0MSTOATDU006UGAX introduce a pro-active staff application mechanic, but testing it is hard as it is a random event. Add an option to the debug menu in the settings panel that will force a staff member to apply every turn. This should be an on/off toggle. It should indicate the current % chance of a staff member applying.
data.title: Add a 'Staff Application' cheat to the dev debug menu
